question: Does the 1-step cloud-threading mechanism (expand outward under a connectability tube + brightness filter) work, and does truth thread continuously?
hypothesis: Truth threads continuously through the connectability tube and per-pair derived omega is an informative per-step omega estimate.
narrative_md: 1-step threading mechanism check on seed 89 anchor t=208 (clean-dim, |C_t|=48, 5 clusters). Mechanism works: truth is in the largest cluster (8.6 deg to nearest survivor); both adjacent epochs preserve all 5 clusters at 54-72% brightness retention. Truth's actual step (1.75 deg) matches |omega|*dt (1.73 deg). But per-pair derived omega from the tube spreads uniformly (|w| 0-1.5 dps, axis err 2-90 deg) -- NOT informative as a per-step omega estimate. Tracks truth-cluster lineage (truth read as input).
